title: Grounded Continuation: A Linear-Time Runtime Verifier for LLM Conversations
authors: Qisong He; Yi Dong; Xiaowei Huang
why_relevant: Proposes a runtime verifier for interactional grounding in LLM conversations, with a transcript-RAG baseline comparison and brief mention of context-manipulation attacks.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on conversation grounding/dependency tracking, not on RAG robustness, retrieval noise, or evidence conflict in the survey's sense.
